title: MATH-SYNC v1.1: Reproducible Computational Pipeline for Robust and Identifiable Affine-Clock Alignment of Heterogeneous Multirate Sensor Streams
description: MATH-SYNC v1.1 preserves the complete frozen v1.0 computational validation release and adds reviewer-driven supplementary analyses developed under a separately frozen protocol. The new G12 analyses evaluate alternative robust estimators, anchor-count and temporal-span sensitivity, reference-stream sensitivity, convergence tolerance, and computational scaling. The release includes frozen G12 specifications, reusable computational modules, raw and summarized results, Supplementary Tables S2-S5, automated tests, environment specifications, and SHA-256 integrity metadata. The original v1.0 validation architecture and results remain unchanged. Raw Harvard and WESAD datasets are not redistributed.
